package ap

// ddsonic contract helper for the base-compatible mechanism probes
// (audio_baseprobe_contract_test.go.txt). Like ap_helper.go.txt, it exists
// only in the overlay the contract runner builds, over the staged base or
// active tree; it is in no real copy of the SDK and in no ddsonic build. It
// names only what go-librespot v0.9.1 already has.

// DDSonicSubscribers is how many subscriptions a has for packets of type t:
// whether a key service has registered with the access point.
func DDSonicSubscribers(a *Accesspoint, t PacketType) int {
	a.recvChansLock.RLock()
	defer a.recvChansLock.RUnlock()
	return len(a.recvChans[t])
}
